doc.title: Ted Piltzecker interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 10, 2019

title: Shearing on doing it for fifty or sixty years
summary: Shearing's answer at a clinic about how he does it, and the ten-thousand-hours idea.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: I mean just the experience, just to have done that for fifty or sixty years. I’ve heard George, I brought him to another institution to do a clinic and someone said, “How do you do that Mr. Shearing.” He says, “You’ve just got to do it for about fifty or sixty years.”
You’ll get there just keep doing it.
Yeah, ten thousand hours to develop expertise is nothing at all.
